transcriber_notes: Measured on the embedded 6160x2832 chart raster in the PDF (page render crops nothing; right part of raster is blank). Boundaries printed on the right axis (71/67/54/53/47/46/41/18/7/0), all confirmed by bar edges at 36.79 px/cm. Hardness from bar ends against the I/K/P/1F/4F/F grid (260 px/class, thirds as +/-): 41-18 cm bar ends exactly on the P- third line; others on class lines. Densities are printed at ~65/60/50/44/33/13/4 cm and assigned to the containing layer (none on a boundary). Temperature: red polyline without markers; break points at 71/61/51/41/31/21/11/1 cm recorded. Calibration: 0 C = right edge of hardness area (per Avanet rule), 46.3 px/C from the evenly spaced axis labels; no air-temp line is drawn to cross-check; +-0.2 C. The horizontal red line at 54 cm is a highlight, not part of the temperature profile. Linked-circle glyph (circles with inner bars, joined) mapped to MFcr.
